SUCCESS: goal entry AND no confirmed geometric overlap AND no footprint outside corridor
SAFETY_FAILURE: confirmed geometric overlap OR footprint outside corridor (existing SE2 arcs, axis extrema checked)
OTHER_TERMINATION: conservative_contact_stop or other non-goal termination without confirmed geometric collision/corridor intrusion; preserve original termination reason
MARGIN_VIOLATION: Separate sum of positive-duration 72Hz intervals with any obstacle swept lower bound <.02m; no change to SUCCESS/SAFETY_FAILURE
margin_duration_note: Inspection-interval duration, not exact threshold-crossing time; overlapping obstacle violations counted once
label: PHASE3_STAGE1_S0_DELAY
technical_failure_policy: Record and continue to next unattempted job; never rerun
scope_label: N=5 exploratory; Oracle geometry evaluation; SE(2) kinematic Isaac Sim
STUCK: simulation_timeout at 90s with no collision/corridor breach/goal

metrics.A_to_B_distance: sum of 72Hz executed XY segment lengths from observation snapshot tick to actual switch tick; report chord displacement separately
metrics.yaw: absolute wrapped net yaw; signed net and total absolute yaw also retained
metrics.staleness: original PP nearest projection arclength at B / original observation-anchored FRESH XY path length; no invented timestamps; invalid path=null
metrics.handoff_population: all actual switches except first without OLD; received but unswitched excluded and counted
metrics.endpoint_clamp: remaining tracked path length < .25m at valid PP control ticks; report fraction of all control ticks and of valid PP ticks
metrics.curvature_saturation: |kappa_PP|>2/m implies omega clipping at fixed v=.2; computed from PP target, no variable-speed threshold substitution
metrics.release_interval: monotonic controller-side receive/release interval; GPU inference reported separately
metrics.margin: 72Hz interval lower bound < .02; independent of outcome
metrics.failure_last_fresh: last 3 actually applied FRESH before termination, no received-only prediction
metrics.condition_handoff_summary: pooled event percentiles descriptive only; per-run summaries separately, N=5 remains experiment unit
metrics.pacing: logged integration lateness and actual wall/simulation ratio; never conflate host and simulation clocks

stage2.rule: D>0 and verified successes<=3 of5: smallest two such D (or one). Technical failures remain explicit and weaken interpretation.
stage2.robust: If every positive D has >=4 successes, report robust up to750ms in these N5 S0 trials and no handoff-correction need established; stop.

d0_comparison: same seed, new90s ceiling vs original60; report exact prefix, RGB/request/pose differences, no deterministic assumption
